title: Revit approved view template and governed display state
test_intent: Determine whether applicable Revit views use the governed template for their purpose and whether template-controlled graphics, filters, linked-model visibility, phase, detail level, and visual style remain free of unexplained local drift.

applicability.applies_when: The tested Revit model contains views whose purpose is governed by an approved view template or governed display-state rule.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested scope contains no view requiring a governed template or display-state rule.

required_evidence: inventory of applicable Revit views and their purpose/type
approved view-template mapping for each applicable purpose/type
observed applied template and controlled view properties
record of approved view exceptions where applicable

result_logic.pass: Every applicable view uses the approved template or approved exception and its governed display state matches the expected template-controlled properties without unexplained overrides.
result_logic.fail: An applicable view uses the wrong or no required template, or has an unexplained override or display-state deviation from an available governed rule.
result_logic.not_applicable: No view in the tested scope requires a governed template or display-state rule.
result_logic.indeterminate: The applicable View Template Registry, purpose mapping, or required expected-property set is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E ATS for view-template conformance. Exact source-era template names remain noncanonical until a governed View Template Registry exists.
